newsitem.title: USA: CCF Holding sets special $0.25/shr div.
newsitem.headline: CCF Holding sets special $0.25/shr div.

text.p: CCF Holding Co said it declared a special cash dividend of $0.25 a share, pay date January 15 and record date December 25.
The special dividend is in addition to the company's regular, semi-annual cash dividend of $0.25 a share payable the same day.
The company added that it decided to pay the dividend because of continued profitability.
The company is the holding company for Clayton County Federal Savings and Loan Association.
